failures.title: rescheduling moves the same appointment in the list and the schedule and keeps the change in its history

disposition: The phone fixture refused after its documented 23:20 limit. The desktop fixture was admitted at 23:16 but its 30-minute meeting reschedule crossed midnight: My Work correctly removed the meeting from Today. The branch fixture extension had not reserved this reschedule. Unchanged main retains the previously reproduced earlier 21:30 refusal. This test-only correction reserves the full reschedule inside Today and therefore refuses after 22:55 Brisbane; it preserves real product/database clocks, every browser assertion and appointment duration. The exact regression fails before the correction and all 10 focused fixture/work-view tests pass afterward. The failed run was cancelled only after the browser artifact upload succeeded. Final-head CI remains the PR check record.
